purpose: Teach: 精神病/思索/低温/男系/蛋白/環状/中等/疑似

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、精神病院での事案を、警察、慎重に扱われますね
lines.en: So with this case—the incident at the psychiatric hospital—the police are handling it carefully, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, curious tone. Slight upward lilt at the end like he's genuinely asking, not leading. Pause before naming the hospital type—careful word choice. Respectful distance in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の思索パターンを分析されますね
lines.en: Yes, the police are analyzing the suspect's thinking patterns in detail.
lines.style: Professional, assured. Even pace. No hesitation—this is his domain. Warm but official, like he's confirming competence without boasting. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、低温で保管された証拠物を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And this case—with the evidence stored at low temperature—the police are managing that carefully too, aren't they?
lines.style: Curious, probing gently. Slight emphasis on 'low temperature' like he's testing whether that detail matters. Thoughtful pause before the question tag. Still deferential but engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、男系族族の家督争いも扱います
lines.en: The police also handle inheritance disputes within family lines—matters like that.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, authoritative. Quick, efficient delivery. Not condescending, just laying out scope. Slight edge of 'we cover more than you think' without saying it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、蛋白質鑑定で犯人特定を、警察、進められますね
lines.en: So with this case—the protein analysis to identify the suspect—the police are moving forward on that, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, technical. Slight slower on 'protein analysis'—respecting the precision. Soft question at the end, like he's checking in. Gentle but engaged.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、環状道路でのひき逃げ事件も扱います
lines.en: The police also investigate hit-and-run incidents on the ring road.
lines.style: Straightforward, efficient. Steady rhythm. Listing scope like items on a list—professional without being cold. Slight weight on 'hit-and-run' like it matters just as much.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、中等学校での事案を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: And this case—the incident at the secondary school—the police are handling that as well, aren't they?
lines.style: Quiet focus. Delicate on 'secondary school'—this might involve minors. Thoughtful pause before the question. Still respectful, still curious, but slightly protective in tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、疑似餌詐欺事件も捜査されますね
lines.en: And the police do investigate fraud cases involving fake lures too, yes?
lines.style: Knowing, warm. Closer to conversational now—almost conspiratorial, like he respects how broad the work is. Slight smile in the voice. Ending with 'yes?' like he's inviting agreement, not doubting.
